entries.source:
IMPERIAL PURSUIT
The Empire pursues the Rebels
as they flee Yavin base.
entries.target_zh_TW:
帝國追擊
反抗軍撤離雅文基地，
帝國隨即展開追擊。

entries.source:
Tour of Duty IV
IMPERIAL PURSUIT
entries.target_zh_TW:
第四服役期
帝國追擊

entries.source:
Having achieved its greatest victory by destroying the Empire's dreaded Death Star, the Rebellion gains new allies.  Emperor Palpatine, furious at his defeat has sent a huge armada to destroy the Rebel base at Yavin.

Despite their new strength, the Alliance can not withstand another attack from the Imperial fleet and must flee their base.
entries.target_zh_TW:
摧毀了帝國令人聞風喪膽的死星，反抗軍贏得空前的勝利，也獲得了新的盟友。白卜庭皇帝對這次挫敗大為震怒，派出一支龐大的艦隊前往摧毀雅文的反抗軍基地。

儘管實力增強，聯盟仍無法抵擋帝國艦隊的再次攻擊，只能撤離基地。

entries.source:
Escort Alliance
Corvettes carrying base
personnel in the 
evacuation of Yavin.
entries.target_zh_TW:
護航載有
基地人員的聯盟
護衛艦，完成
雅文撤離行動。
>任務 1：護航撤離雅文的護衛艦

entries.source: Though Alliance losses were severe, the [[Death Star's ]]destruction was a great victory.  Even so, there is little time for celebration.  With the Empire's discovery of our secret base on [[Yavin]], we find ourselves on the run again.$  All personnel on [[Yavin]] must be evacuated.  There cannot be much time left before an Imperial invasion force arrives.  Alliance Command is asking for help from the [[Defiance]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 儘管聯盟損失慘重，摧毀[[死星]]仍是一場偉大的勝利。即使如此，我們幾乎沒有時間慶祝。帝國發現了我們在[[雅文]]的秘密基地，我們又得再次逃亡。$  [[雅文]]上的所有人員都必須撤離。帝國的入侵部隊隨時可能抵達。聯盟指揮部正請求[[不屈號]]提供協助。

entries.source: A-Wing[[ Red One]] will escort Alliance Corvettes in the evacuation of [[Yavin]].
entries.target_zh_TW: A翼[[紅色一號]]將護航聯盟護衛艦撤離[[雅文]]。

entries.source: Stay alert and ready for an Imperial attack on our fleeing ships.
entries.target_zh_TW: 保持警戒，隨時準備應對帝國對我方撤離船艦的攻擊。

entries.source: This convoy is carrying the last of our personnel from the [[Yavin Base]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 這支船團載著[[雅文基地]]最後一批人員。

entries.source: Our fleet is now scattering throughout the galaxy.  Escape and survival are our main concern.$  Welcome back, we all missed you.  Your starfighter is the only one available to see five Corvettes safely to their jump point.  They will take about [[17]] minutes to reach it.  Glad to have you aboard, Red One!
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們的艦隊正分散到銀河各處。脫逃與生存是我們的首要考量。$  歡迎歸隊，我們都很想念你。你的星際戰機是唯一能護送五艘護衛艦安全抵達躍遷點的戰機。它們大約需要 [[17]] 分鐘才能抵達。很高興有你加入，紅色一號！

entries.source: T/Bs are the main threat.  Don't let them launch their torpedoes.  There are 3 sets of 4 T/Bs followed by 2 sets of 3 T/Bs.  Engage T/Bs as close to the FRG as possible, but stay out of the FRG's gun range.$  You will be harassed by a pair of T/Fs (with 1 replacement wave).  Evade them whenever T/Bs are present.  Kill them when convenient.$
entries.target_zh_TW: 鈦轟炸機是主要威脅，別讓它們發射魚雷。共有 3 組各 4 架的鈦轟炸機，接著是 2 組各 3 架。盡量在靠近巡防艦處攔截鈦轟炸機，但要待在巡防艦的砲火射程之外。$  你會遭到一對鈦戰機騷擾（有 1 波補充）。只要有鈦轟炸機在場就避開它們，方便時再擊落。$

entries.source: There will be four Freighters loaded with foodstuffs retreating ahead of you.  If they come under attack, you are to remain with [[Crescent]] Squadron. Our personnel are more important than our supplies!$
entries.target_zh_TW: 將有四艘載滿糧食的貨船在你前方撤退。如果它們遭到攻擊，你仍須留在[[新月]]中隊身邊。我們的人員比補給更重要！$

entries.source: THANKS FOR YOUR HELP, RED ONE!
entries.target_zh_TW: 謝謝你的協助，紅色一號！

entries.source: IT'S GOOD TO SEE YOU BACK IN THE BATTLE!
entries.target_zh_TW: 很高興看到你重返戰場！
我們非常需要你的本領

entries.source:
Protect Alliance forces
as they head to their
jump points during the
retreat from Yavin.
entries.target_zh_TW:
在撤離雅文期間，
保護聯盟部隊
前往各自的
躍遷點。

entries.source: There will be two groups of Transports (three in each), one group of three Shuttles and two Freighters. You must ensure that they all escape to safety.$  There are a pair of Nav Buoys to mark the entrance and exit jump points.  Patrol this area and intercept any Imperial attackers.
entries.target_zh_TW: 共有兩組運輸艦（每組三艘）、一組三艘穿梭機及兩艘貨船。你必須確保它們全部安全脫逃。$  一對導航浮標標示了入口與出口躍遷點。在此區域巡邏，攔截任何帝國攻擊者。

entries.source: Alliance forces are fleeing [[Yavin]].  This is one of the escape routes.
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟部隊正在撤離[[雅文]]，這是其中一條撤退路線。

entries.source: The convoy's entry and exit points are marked with Nav Buoys.
entries.target_zh_TW: 船團的入口與出口點以導航浮標標示。

entries.source: Two X-wings will be sent ahead to guard a transit point on their path.
entries.target_zh_TW: 兩架 X翼戰機將先行出發，守衛他們路線上的一處中繼點。

entries.source: As you may have noted during the last mission, most of the Alliance Fleet's food supply was destroyed by the Empire.  This is cause for grave concern, but first we must continue to evade Imperial forces.$  As soon as two X-wings from [[Red]] Squadron are ready, you will be sent back out to aid more of our fleeing ships.  A transit point along their retreat route needs guarding.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你可能在上一次任務中已經注意到，聯盟艦隊的糧食補給大多已被帝國摧毀。這令人極為憂心，但我們必須先繼續躲避帝國部隊。$  一旦[[紅色]]中隊的兩架 X翼戰機準備就緒，你就會再次出擊，支援更多撤離中的船艦。他們撤退路線上的一處中繼點需要守衛。

entries.source: Watch for the arrival of enemy TRNs at [[5]] and [[12 ]]minutes into the mission.  They carry torpedoes and launch at the Freighters.  Use duel torpedoes on the first three, then finish off the fourth with lasers.$  The GUN pairs enter on the destruction of the previous.  So kill one GUN fast then play with its wingman.  If you are doing good, two pairs of GUNs will enter.  A STD will enter, too late and far away.
entries.target_zh_TW: 注意敵方運輸艦會在任務開始後第 [[5]] 與第 [[12]] 分鐘抵達。它們攜帶魚雷，會朝貨船發射。對前三艘使用雙發魚雷，再用雷射砲解決第四艘。$  砲艇以兩架為一組，前一組被摧毀後才會進場。所以先迅速擊落一架砲艇，再慢慢對付它的僚機。如果你表現良好，會有兩組砲艇進場。一艘滅星者也會進場，但為時已晚且距離很遠。

entries.source: The convoy is made up of four groups of ships.
You are to remain on station until relieved by X-wing [[Blue]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 你必須留守崗位，直到 X翼[[藍色]]中隊前來接替。

entries.source: X-WING BLUE HAS ARRIVED TO RELIEVE YOU
entries.target_zh_TW: X翼藍色中隊已前來接替你
撤離巡洋艦馬克西姆斯號

entries.source:
The Alliance Cruiser
Maximus has been caught in
an Imperial ambush.  Help
rescue its crew from
impending catastrophe.
entries.target_zh_TW:
聯盟巡洋艦
馬克西姆斯號陷入
帝國的埋伏。協助
救出艦上船員，
使其免於災難。
>任務 3：巡洋艦馬克西姆斯號遇伏

entries.source: CRS [[Maximus]] is caught in an Imperial ambush and can't hold out for long.
entries.target_zh_TW: 巡洋艦[[馬克西姆斯號]]陷入帝國埋伏，撐不了多久。

entries.source: The Imperial STD [[Nihil]] is inflicting a savage beating and launching TIEs.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國滅星者[[虛無號]]正猛烈痛擊我方，並派出鈦戰機。

entries.source: As many of the crew as possible will try to escape in SHUs and TRNs.
entries.target_zh_TW: 將有盡可能多的船員嘗試搭乘穿梭機與運輸艦逃離。

entries.source: The Alliance Frigate[[ Anvil]] will precede the others to a safe location.
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟巡防艦[[鐵砧號]]將先於其他船艦前往安全地點。

entries.source: X-wing [[Red]] will come to the aid of A-wing [[Blue]] to screen their withdrawal.
entries.target_zh_TW: X翼[[紅色]]中隊將前往支援 A翼[[藍色]]中隊，掩護他們撤離。

entries.source: In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin]], the Alliance fleet has scattered as they flee to escape destruction.  One unfortunate task force led by the Cruiser [[Maximus]] has been caught in an Imperial ambush.$  The [[Maximus's]] crew has begun to abandon ship.  The remnants of [[Blue]] Squadron's A-wings are making a last ditch effort to protect their withdrawal.  You are to hyperspace to their aid immediately.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[雅文戰役]]之後，聯盟艦隊為了逃避毀滅而四散撤離。一支由巡洋艦[[馬克西姆斯號]]率領的特遣隊不幸陷入帝國的埋伏。$  [[馬克西姆斯號]]的船員已開始棄艦。[[藍色]]中隊殘存的 A翼戰機正在做最後一搏，掩護他們撤離。你必須立即躍入超空間前往支援。

entries.source: You are to ensure that all escaping [[Shuttles]] and [[Transports]] make it to the jump point.  Imperial forces will be in pursuit.  Move as quickly as you can to intercept any enemy starfighters.$  The Empire isn't just trying to crush the Rebellion now.  They want revenge for the loss of the [[Death Star]]!  The [[Emperor]] is more determined than ever to exterminate the Alliance once and for all!
entries.target_zh_TW: 你必須確保所有逃離的[[穿梭機]]與[[運輸艦]]抵達躍遷點。帝國部隊將緊追在後。盡快行動，攔截任何敵方星際戰機。$  帝國現在不只是想粉碎反抗軍，他們還要為失去[[死星]]報仇！[[皇帝]]比以往任何時候都更決心要將聯盟一舉殲滅！

entries.source: Only the Shuttles are in any real danger.  To reach them ASAP, redirect shield power to the engines to get your speed up to at least [[112]].$  T/F Theta is the greatest threat to the SHUs.  T/Bs Alpha and Delta will also target them once the [[Maximus]] is destroyed.$   You will be attacked by T/F Gamma and T/Is Beta and Eta.  Engage only when no enemy is attacking the Shuttles.
entries.target_zh_TW: 只有穿梭機真正身陷危險。為了盡快趕到它們身邊，將護盾能量轉移到引擎，把速度提高到至少 [[112]]。$  Theta 鈦戰機是穿梭機的最大威脅。[[馬克西姆斯號]]被摧毀後，Alpha 與 Delta 鈦轟炸機也會以它們為目標。$   你會遭到 Gamma 鈦戰機以及 Beta、Eta 鈦攔截機攻擊。只有在沒有敵機攻擊穿梭機時才與它們交戰。

entries.source: YOU DID ALL YOU COULD, RED ONE, LET'S GO HOME
entries.target_zh_TW: 你已經盡力了，紅色一號，我們回家吧

entries.source: THE LOSS OF THE MAXIMUS IS A TERRIBLE SETBACK!
entries.target_zh_TW: 失去馬克西姆斯號是一次慘重的挫敗！

entries.source: AT LEAST WE SAVED AS MUCH OF THE CREW AS WE COULD
entries.target_zh_TW: 至少我們已盡可能救出了船員

entries.source:
Protect the Alliance
Frigate Anvil while it
receives needed supplies.
entries.target_zh_TW:
在聯盟巡防艦鐵砧號
接收所需補給時
保護它。

entries.source: A-wing [[Red]] and X-wing [[Gold]] will fly a defensive patrol of the area.
entries.target_zh_TW: A翼[[紅色]]中隊與 X翼[[金色]]中隊將在該區域進行防禦巡邏。

entries.source: A-wing [[Red]] and X-wing [[Gold]] are to provide area security during the operation.  The transfer will take [[four]] minutes and then both ships will jump into hyperspace.$  Be prepared to intercept any Imperial attack.  The [[Anvil]] has only two A-wings left on board.  They are out of missiles, though, so will not be as effective.
entries.target_zh_TW: A翼[[紅色]]中隊與 X翼[[金色]]中隊負責在行動期間維護區域安全。轉運將耗時[[四]]分鐘，之後兩艘船艦都會躍入超空間。$  隨時準備攔截帝國的任何攻擊。[[鐵砧號]]上只剩兩架 A翼戰機，而且飛彈已經用盡，因此戰力有限。

entries.source: The Alliance Frigate [[Anvil]] is in desperate need of resupply.
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟巡防艦[[鐵砧號]]急需補給。

entries.source: The Corvette [[Lauhu]] will arrive soon to deliver these supplies.
entries.target_zh_TW: 護衛艦[[勞胡號]]即將抵達，運送這批補給。

entries.source: The attack begins with a group of four GUNs.  Destroy them ASAP.$  The Imperial FRG makes three attack runs.  3 T/Bs and 3 T/Is are launched during each of the first two.  On the third attack two groups of two T/Bs each are launched.  Each has two follow up waves.$  The Bombers are the primary threat.  Ignore the Interceptors until all Bombers are destroyed.$
entries.target_zh_TW: 攻擊從一組四架砲艇開始，盡快摧毀它們。$  帝國巡防艦會發動三輪攻擊。前兩輪各會派出 3 架鈦轟炸機與 3 架鈦攔截機。第三輪攻擊會派出兩組各兩架的鈦轟炸機。每組都有兩波後續增援。$  轟炸機是首要威脅。在所有轟炸機被摧毀之前，不要理會攔截機。$

entries.source: The loss of the [[Maximus]] is the most serious blow the Alliance has suffered since [[Yavin]].  The Frigate [[Anvil]] is another ship from the same task force whose crew has fought well but taken heavy losses.$  The [[Anvil's]] situation is precarious. The Corvette [[Lauhu]] will arrive moments after you to deliver supplies. If this operation is disrupted, the [[Anvil]] will not survive another attack.
entries.target_zh_TW: 失去[[馬克西姆斯號]]是聯盟自[[雅文]]以來遭受的最沉重打擊。巡防艦[[鐵砧號]]是同一支特遣隊的另一艘船艦，它的船員奮勇作戰，卻也損失慘重。$  [[鐵砧號]]的處境岌岌可危。護衛艦[[勞胡號]]將在你抵達後不久前來運送補給。如果這次行動遭到破壞，[[鐵砧號]]將撐不過下一次攻擊。

entries.source: THE ANVIL HAS ESCAPED, RETURN TO BASE
entries.target_zh_TW: 鐵砧號已經脫險，返回基地

entries.source: GOOD SHOOTING, RED TWO, THANKS FOR YOUR HELP!
entries.target_zh_TW: 射得好，紅色二號，謝謝你的協助！

entries.source:
The Frigate Anvil is
hopelessly damaged and
must be abandoned.  Guard
the evacuation, then 
scuttle the ship.
entries.target_zh_TW:
巡防艦鐵砧號
已損毀至無法修復，
必須棄艦。守衛
撤離行動，然後
將該艦摧毀。

entries.source: The Frigate [[Anvil]] was severely mauled while trying to receive supplies.
entries.target_zh_TW: 巡防艦[[鐵砧號]]在試圖接收補給時遭到重創。

entries.source: The Frigate [[Anvil]] was so badly damaged during the last attack that it barely escaped.  Now it must be abandoned and scuttled.$  The Corvette [[Hart]] and three Transports will arrive to pick up the [[Anvil's]] surviving crew.  This will take about [[7]] minutes.$  As soon as the [[Hart]] has completed docking, [[Red One]] is to destroy the [[Anvil ]]to prevent its capture by the Empire.
entries.target_zh_TW: 巡防艦[[鐵砧號]]在上一次攻擊中受損嚴重，勉強才得以脫逃。現在必須棄艦並將其摧毀。$  護衛艦[[哈特號]]與三艘運輸艦將前來接走[[鐵砧號]]倖存的船員，約需 [[7]] 分鐘。$  [[哈特號]]一完成對接，[[紅色一號]]就要摧毀[[鐵砧號]]，以免它落入帝國手中。

entries.source: There isn't time to repair the ship so now it must be abandoned.
entries.target_zh_TW: 已經沒有時間修復這艘船艦，現在必須棄艦。

entries.source: The Corvette [[Hart]] and several Transports will evacuate the crew.
entries.target_zh_TW: 護衛艦[[哈特號]]與數艘運輸艦將撤離船員。

entries.source: X-wing [[Red]] [[One]] will then scuttle the [[Anvil]] to prevent it being captured.
entries.target_zh_TW: X翼[[紅色]][[一號]]隨後將摧毀[[鐵砧號]]，以免它被俘。

entries.source: Then escort the evacuation ships to the jump point.  Y-wing [[Gold]] will help.
entries.target_zh_TW: 接著護航撤離船艦前往躍遷點。Y翼[[金色]]中隊將提供協助。

entries.source: You must ensure that Corvette [[Hart]] and all Transports escape to safety. Two Y-wings from [[Gold]] Squadron are available if attacked.$  Imperial Corvette Squadron [[Viper]] is patrolling this sector in search of the [[Anvil's ]]task force.  Their orders are to hunt down and kill all fleeing Alliance forces.$  Also, many squadrons of Assault Gunboats have fanned out through the sector as advance scouts.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你必須確保護衛艦[[哈特號]]與所有運輸艦安全脫逃。若遭到攻擊，[[金色]]中隊有兩架 Y翼戰機可供支援。$  帝國[[毒蛇]]護衛艦中隊正在此星區巡邏，搜尋[[鐵砧號]]所屬的特遣隊。他們奉命追殺所有逃離的聯盟部隊。$  此外，許多突擊砲艇中隊也已散布在整個星區，擔任先遣偵察。

entries.source: Intercept and destroy GUN Mu ASAP.  When CRV [[Viper 7]] enters, order your wingmen to attack.  Use 2 torps yourself.$  Take out TRNs next then finish off the [[Anvil]].  Catch up with the [[Hart]].$  Destroy [[Viper 1]] as far from the [[Hart]] as possible.  Use remaining 4 torps and wingmen assist.  Then into [[Viper 2's]] blind spot to kill.  Order wingmen to attack incoming waves of GUN Tau.
entries.target_zh_TW: 盡快攔截並摧毀 Mu 砲艇。當護衛艦[[毒蛇 7]]進場時，命令你的僚機發動攻擊。你自己發射 2 枚魚雷。$  接著解決運輸艦，然後摧毀[[鐵砧號]]。追上[[哈特號]]。$  在離[[哈特號]]盡可能遠的地方摧毀[[毒蛇 1]]。用剩下的 4 枚魚雷，並讓僚機協助。然後繞到[[毒蛇 2]]的盲點將它擊毀。命令僚機攻擊一波波來襲的 Tau 砲艇。

entries.source: THE ANVIL'S CREW IS SAFE, GOOD WORK
entries.target_zh_TW: 鐵砧號的船員已經安全，幹得好

entries.source: THANKS FOR YOUR HELP, NOW RETURN TO BASE
entries.target_zh_TW: 謝謝你的協助，現在返回基地

entries.source:
Guard a Rebel Alliance
Freighter during repair 
operations.  Its cargo is
essential to the Rebellion.
entries.target_zh_TW:
在反抗軍聯盟貨船
維修期間守衛它。
它的貨物對反抗軍
至關重要。

entries.source: Our Freighter [[Op Mus]] has been disabled and is awaiting repairs.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們的貨船[[歐普穆斯號]]已被癱瘓，正在等待維修。

entries.source: Two X-wings from[[ Red Squadron ]]will be sent to guard the repair operation.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色中隊]]的兩架 X翼戰機將奉命守衛維修作業。

entries.source: As you know the escape from [[Yavin]] has been fraught with difficulties and setbacks.  Our food stocks are critically low.  It is imperative that we protect any remaining supplies.$  The Freighter [[Op Mus]] is carrying a load of grain that represents the bulk of these supplies.  Unfortunately, [[Op Mus]] has broken down in deep space!$  [[Red]] Squadron will send two X-wings to guard over it.
entries.target_zh_TW: 如你所知，撤離[[雅文]]的過程中困難與挫折不斷。我們的糧食存量已經嚴重不足，必須保護剩下的每一份補給。$  貨船[[歐普穆斯號]]載運的穀物佔了這些補給的大宗。不幸的是，[[歐普穆斯號]]在深空中故障了！$  [[紅色]]中隊將派出兩架 X翼戰機守衛它。

entries.source: Transport [[Jaamn]] is en route and will deliver a repair crew within moments.
entries.target_zh_TW: 運輸艦[[賈姆恩號]]正在途中，很快就會送來維修小組。

entries.source: The Transport [[Jaamn]] will deliver a repair crew moments after you pop out of hyperspace.  The repairs will take approximately [[10]] minutes.$  X-wing [[Red]] is to protect the repair operation from Imperial attack.$  The Empire isn't our only enemy now. We're also threatened by starvation! This grain is essential to the survival of the Alliance.
entries.target_zh_TW: 在你脫離超空間後不久，運輸艦[[賈姆恩號]]就會送來維修小組。維修約需 [[10]] 分鐘。$  X翼[[紅色]]中隊負責保護維修作業免受帝國攻擊。$  帝國不再是我們唯一的敵人，飢荒同樣威脅著我們！這批穀物攸關聯盟的存亡。

entries.source: You will be attacked by many groups of GUNs.  Whenever ships have waves, or enter on the destruction of a previous group, kill all but one in a group. Then play with the last ship. This will slow the arrival of the next group. $  Neutral FRTs and Y-Ws will appear 7:20 minutes after the mission starts.  Ignore them and continue to go after the GUNs.  The Y-Ws may help you against the GUNs.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你會遭到許多組砲艇攻擊。凡是會分波出現、或在前一組被摧毀後才進場的敵機，每組只留下一架，其餘全部擊落，然後再慢慢對付最後一架。這樣可以延緩下一組的抵達。 $  中立的貨船與 Y翼戰機會在任務開始後 7 分 20 秒出現。不要理會它們，繼續追擊砲艇。這些 Y翼戰機可能會幫你對付砲艇。

entries.source: HEAD HOME BEFORE MORE IMPERIAL FORCES ARRIVE
entries.target_zh_TW: 趁更多帝國部隊抵達前返航

entries.source:
Protect a vital supply
container while an Alliance
transport recovers it.
entries.target_zh_TW:
在聯盟運輸艦回收
一個重要補給貨櫃時
保護它。

entries.source: As we continue to evade the Empire's pursuit our survival becomes ever more doubtful.  Because of the loss of most of our food supplies it is imperative that we find new sources.$  In the meantime there is one lost cache of grain available to us.  It is in a Cargo Container in the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster]].  The Container was dropped by one of our ships in an attempt to elude an Imperial attack.
entries.target_zh_TW: 在我們持續躲避帝國追擊的同時，我們的存活希望也愈來愈渺茫。由於失去了大部分糧食補給，我們必須設法找到新的來源。$  在此期間，我們還能取得一批遺失的穀物。它位於[[小普魯里奧德星團]]中的一個貨櫃裡。這個貨櫃是我們的一艘船艦為了躲避帝國攻擊而拋下的。

entries.source: A Container full of grain was dropped in the [[Lesser]] [[Plooriod Cluster]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 一個裝滿穀物的貨櫃被拋棄在[[小]][[普魯里奧德星團]]。

entries.source: X-wing [[Red]] will jump to this location immediately to protect it.
entries.target_zh_TW: X翼[[紅色]]中隊將立即躍遷至此處保護它。

entries.source: Our Freighter [[Trips]] is to retrieve the grain and will arrive in [[7]] minutes.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們的貨船[[崔普斯號]]將負責回收穀物，並在 [[7]] 分鐘後抵達。

entries.source: The retrieval itself will only take [[2]] minutes and then the [[Trips]] will leave.
entries.target_zh_TW: 回收作業只需 [[2]] 分鐘，之後[[崔普斯號]]就會離開。

entries.source: The ship's commander was unaware of our overall supply situation.  The Freighter [[Trips]] is being sent to retrieve the grain before it is destroyed by Imperial forces.$  [[Red]] Squadron will send two X-wings to intercept any attacking Imperials.  When the [[Trips]] arrives X-wing [[Red]] will be responsible for defending the operation from Imperial attack.
entries.target_zh_TW: 那艘船的指揮官並不清楚我們整體的補給狀況。貨船[[崔普斯號]]正奉命趕在穀物被帝國部隊摧毀前將其回收。$  [[紅色]]中隊將派出兩架 X翼戰機攔截任何來襲的帝國軍。[[崔普斯號]]抵達後，X翼[[紅色]]中隊將負責保護這次行動免受帝國攻擊。

entries.source: X-wing [[Red]] must ensure the completion of this transfer.
entries.target_zh_TW: X翼[[紅色中隊]]必須確保這次轉運順利完成。

entries.source: A FRG has already launched 4 T/Fs and 4 T/Bs.  Move to intercept T/F Alpha, but not too quickly.  Stay within 8 klicks of the Container you are protecting.$  A specially modified CRV will pop up 3:18 minutes into the mission.  48 seconds later it will launch a single T/B (with 2 replacements).  Use your torpedoes in dual fire mode to destroy the CRV before the T/B is launched, then go after T/B Beta.
entries.target_zh_TW: 一艘巡防艦已放出 4 架鈦戰機和 4 架鈦轟炸機。前去攔截鈦戰機 Alpha 編隊，但別太快。與你所保護的貨櫃保持在 8 公里以內。$  任務開始 3:18 後，一艘經過特殊改裝的護衛艦會突然出現。48 秒後它會放出一架鈦轟炸機（另有 2 架替補）。以雙發模式發射魚雷，在鈦轟炸機升空前摧毀護衛艦，然後追擊鈦轟炸機 Beta 編隊。

entries.source: THE VITAL GRAIN SUPPLY HAS BEEN RECOVERED
entries.target_zh_TW: 重要的穀物補給已經奪回

entries.source: THIS WILL KEEP THE REBELLION ALIVE A LITTLE LONGER
entries.target_zh_TW: 這能讓反抗軍再撐久一點

entries.source:
Capture vital grain
supplies by hiding in an
asteroid field and
ambushing an Imperial
convoy.
entries.target_zh_TW:
藏身於
小行星帶中
伏擊帝國船團，
奪取重要的
穀物補給。

entries.source: Y-wing [[Red One]] will hide in this debris cluster to ambush an Imperial convoy.
entries.target_zh_TW: Y翼[[紅色一號]]將藏身於這片殘骸群中，伏擊帝國船團。

entries.source: Y-wing [[Red One]] will hide in the cluster.  A convoy is due moments after [[Red One]] takes position.  Our intelligence indicates that at least one Transport in the convoy will be carrying food.$  [[Red One]] will identify and disable this ship.  Transport [[Raider ]]and X-Wing [[Gold]] will then drop out of hyperspace and the food will be taken.  [[Red]] and [[Gold]] will protect the operation from Imperial counterattack.
entries.target_zh_TW: Y翼[[紅色一號]]將藏身於殘骸群中。[[紅色一號]]就位後不久，一支船團就會抵達。根據我方情報，船團中至少有一艘運輸艦載有糧食。$  [[紅色一號]]要識別並癱瘓這艘船。接著運輸艦[[突襲者號]]與 X翼[[金色中隊]]會脫離超空間，奪取糧食。[[紅色]]與[[金色]]中隊將保護這次行動，抵禦帝國軍的反擊。

entries.source: Amongst the convoy is at least one Imperial [[Transport]] loaded with food.
entries.target_zh_TW: 船團中至少有一艘滿載糧食的帝國[[運輸艦]]。

entries.source: [[Red One]] must identify and disable any Transport carrying food.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色一號]]必須識別並癱瘓任何載運糧食的運輸艦。

entries.source: Transport [[Raider]] will then deliver a commando team to capture the food.
entries.target_zh_TW: 接著運輸艦[[突襲者號]]會送來一支突擊隊奪取糧食。

entries.source: Additional cover for the raid will be provided by two X-wings from [[Gold]].
entries.target_zh_TW: [[金色中隊]]將派出兩架 X翼戰機，為這次突襲提供額外掩護。

entries.source: [[Red]] and [[Gold]] must keep Imperial forces at bay during the raid.
entries.target_zh_TW: 突襲期間，[[紅色]]與[[金色]]中隊必須牽制住帝國軍。

entries.source: [[Supply and Ordnance Command]] has determined that our situation is critical.  Our food supply is desperately low.  Therefore, a series of raids to steal Imperial food supplies is being planned.$  One of our probes is monitoring traffic near an Imperial Nav Buoy.  The Nav Buoy is located to guide ships past a small cluster of debris.  This cluster offers an ideal location from which to mount an ambush.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[補給與軍械司令部]]判定我們的處境已十分危急。我們的糧食存量極度短缺，因此正規劃一系列突襲行動，奪取帝國的糧食補給。$  我方一具探測器正在監視一座帝國導航浮標附近的往來船隻。這座導航浮標的用途是引導船隻通過一小片殘骸群，而這片殘骸群正是發動伏擊的理想地點。

entries.source: The TRN with the grain is Kappa 6.  (It is the sixth TRN in the target list as you cycle forward on the CMD.)   It will arrive with 5 other TRNs 2:06 minutes into the mission.$  Identifying it triggers the arrival of 3 SHUs which will attack you.  Also, 3 GUNs will arrive to attack you 4 minutes later.
entries.target_zh_TW: 載運穀物的運輸艦是 Kappa 6。（在 CMD 上向前切換目標時，它是目標清單中的第六艘運輸艦。）它會在任務開始 2:06 時與另外 5 艘運輸艦一同抵達。$  識別它之後，會有 3 艘穿梭機出現並攻擊你。此外，4 分鐘後還會有 3 艘砲艇抵達並攻擊你。

entries.source: OUR COMMANDOS HAVE RECOVERED THE FOOD SUPPLY
entries.target_zh_TW: 我方突擊隊已奪得糧食補給

entries.source: IT ISN'T A HUGE TAKE, BUT IT WILL HELP!
entries.target_zh_TW: 收穫不算多，但總有幫助！

entries.source: RETURN TO BASE, BEFORE IMPERIAL REINFORCEMENTS ARRIVE
entries.target_zh_TW: 趁帝國援軍抵達前，返回基地

entries.source:
Clear a minefield that
the Empire has placed
around a hyperspace jump
point that Alliance
convoys use.
entries.target_zh_TW:
清除帝國在聯盟
船團所用的
超空間躍遷點
周圍布下的
雷區。

entries.source: The Empire has deployed a mine field  around one of our Navigational Buoys.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國在我方一座導航浮標周圍布下了雷區。

entries.source: Y-wing [[Red One]] must clear the mine field as quickly as possible.
entries.target_zh_TW: Y翼[[紅色一號]]必須盡快清除雷區。

entries.source: [[Ghorin]] is known to be a heavy handed ruler with no small similarity to the [[Emperor]], so this is suspicious.  Nevertheless, our situation is desperate enough that we must consider his offer.$  An initial shipment is to be delivered to us at a transit point near the edge of [[Ghorin's]] domain.  We have just learned that this area was recently mined and a few of our ships were lost there.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[戈林]]是出了名的鐵腕統治者，作風與[[皇帝]]頗有幾分相似，因此此事十分可疑。儘管如此，我們的處境已危急到必須考慮他的提議。$  第一批貨物將在[[戈林]]領地邊緣附近的一處轉運點交付給我們。我們剛得知，這片區域最近被布了雷，我方已有數艘船隻在那裡損失。

entries.source: This transit point is vital to our plans and must be kept open.
entries.target_zh_TW: 這處轉運點對我們的計畫至關重要，必須保持暢通。

entries.source: Several Alliance ships are already en route and can not be recalled.
entries.target_zh_TW: 數艘聯盟船艦已在途中，無法召回。

entries.source: Our food shortage continues to be a serious problem.  There appears to be a solution, though.  We have been negotiating with [[Overlord Ghorin]], ruler of the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]].$  The [[Plooriods]] contain several agricultural worlds that are major grain exporters.  In fact, [[Ghorin]] has been the principal supplier to the Empire in this sector.  Now he claims to have grown sympathetic to the Rebellion.
entries.target_zh_TW: 糧食短缺仍是我們的嚴重問題。不過，似乎有了解決之道。我們一直在與[[戈林霸主]]談判，他是[[大普魯里奧德星團]]的統治者。$  [[普魯里奧德星團]]中有數個農業世界，是主要的穀物輸出地。事實上，[[戈林]]一直是帝國在此星區的主要供應者。如今他聲稱自己已開始同情反抗軍。

entries.source: [[Red]] Squadron is therefore ordered to send a Y-wing to clear the mine field immediately.  Several Alliance ships are already en route and can not be recalled.  The first of them will arrive less than[[ 7]] minutes after [[Red One]] gets there so you will have be quick!
entries.target_zh_TW: 因此，[[紅色]]中隊奉命立即派出一架 Y翼戰機清除雷區。數艘聯盟船艦已在途中，無法召回。第一艘會在[[紅色一號]]抵達後不到 [[7]] 分鐘內到達，所以你的動作一定要快！

entries.source: Switch to lowest detail.  You must be quick to prevent losses to the friendly ships arriving later.$  Use a few torps on your way in.  Get as close as you can, remember supercharged lasers fire further (1.5 klicks), but even one normal charged blast will do.  Every shot counts so be sure you've got a "green lock".$  Jink and weave between shots. Disengage to recharge, use remaining torpedoes as you reengage.
entries.target_zh_TW: 把畫面細節調到最低。你必須動作迅速，才能避免稍後抵達的友艦受損。$  進場時先發射幾枚魚雷。盡量靠近；記住超充能雷射砲射程較遠（1.5 公里），但即使只是一發一般充能的雷射也足以奏效。每一發都很重要，務必確認已取得「綠色鎖定」。$  兩次射擊之間要閃避迂迴。脫離戰鬥進行充能，重新交戰時用掉剩下的魚雷。

entries.source: THE JUMP POINT AREA HAS BEEN CLEARED
entries.target_zh_TW: 躍遷點區域已清除完畢

entries.source: OUR SHIPS CAN USE THIS VITAL ROUTE FOR THE TIME BEING
entries.target_zh_TW: 我方船艦暫時可以使用這條重要航線了

entries.source:
Destroy an Imperial
communications network that
is placed to eavesdrop on
Alliance convoy operations.
entries.target_zh_TW:
摧毀帝國為竊聽
聯盟船團行動
而設置的
通訊網路。

entries.source: [[Red One]] will lead the raid.  Use your X-wing to clear the minefield and destroy the Communication Satellite.  Once this is done you should prepare to intercept any Imperial response.$  [[Blue]] Squadron will provide four Y-wings to attack the minelaying Corvettes and any other vessels that show up.$
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色一號]]將率領這次突襲。駕駛你的 X翼戰機清除雷區並摧毀通訊衛星。完成後，準備攔截帝國軍的任何反擊。$  [[藍色]]中隊將派出四架 Y翼戰機，攻擊布雷的護衛艦以及任何出現的其他船艦。$

entries.source: Four Y-wings from [[Blue]] Squadron will attack the Corvettes.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[藍色]]中隊的四架 Y翼戰機將攻擊護衛艦。

entries.source: X-wing[[ Red One ]]will clear the minefield and destroy the Comm Sat.
entries.target_zh_TW: X翼[[紅色一號]]將清除雷區並摧毀通訊衛星。

entries.source: Imperial Corvettes are deploying mines around a Communication Satellite.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國護衛艦正在一顆通訊衛星周圍布雷。

entries.source: This diversion is needed to cover ship movements to the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]].  The ruler there, [[Overlord Ghorin]], claims to have grown sympathetic to the Rebellion.$  This is significant because he controls several agricultural worlds.  Our food supply will be secure if [[Ghorin]] joins the Alliance.  We remain skeptical, though, because of [[Ghorin's]] reputation for heavy handed ruthlessness.
entries.target_zh_TW: 這次佯攻是為了掩護我方船艦前往[[大普魯里奧德星團]]的行動。當地統治者[[戈林霸主]]聲稱已開始同情反抗軍。$  此事意義重大，因為他控制著數個農業世界。若[[戈林]]加入聯盟，我們的糧食供應便有保障。不過，由於[[戈林]]素以鐵腕無情著稱，我們仍抱持懷疑。

entries.source: Imperial forces are searching through thousands of remote systems to find us.  Even so, the Empire can't be everywhere at once.  Currently, they are attempting to improve their monitoring ability by enlarging their communications network.$  A new listening station is being constructed near [[Saheelindeel]].  This is far from any Alliance outposts and so will be attacked to divert Imperial attention.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國軍正在數千個偏遠星系中搜尋我們。即便如此，帝國也無法同時無所不在。目前，他們正試圖擴大通訊網路，以提升監控能力。$  一座新的監聽站正在[[薩希林迪爾]]附近興建。此地遠離聯盟的所有前哨站，因此我們將攻擊此處，以轉移帝國的注意力。

entries.source: Concentrate on the mines and satellite.  Don't forget about your six torpedoes.  That could eliminate six mines on your way in.  Watch your shields.  Retreat and power up as necessary, there is no time limit on this mission.  Evade CRVs as much as possible.$  You will be attacked by 3 three ship GUN groups.  Kill GUNs as you wish.$
entries.target_zh_TW: 集中攻擊水雷和衛星。別忘了你的六枚魚雷，進場時就能用它們解決六枚水雷。注意你的護盾。必要時撤退並補充能量，這次任務沒有時間限制。盡量避開護衛艦。$  你會遭到 3 個各 3 艘的砲艇編隊攻擊。要不要擊殺砲艇由你決定。$

entries.target_zh_TW: 這將重創帝國的通訊網路

entries.source: WE'LL TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE RESULTING CONFUSION

Guard a cargo transfer
area as the Alliance
receives grain shipments
from Ghorin's Freighters.
entries.target_zh_TW:
聯盟將從戈林的
貨船接收穀物，
你要守衛
貨物轉運區。

entries.source: A-wings from [[Red]] Squadron will patrol the area around this transit point.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色]]中隊的 A翼戰機將在這處轉運點周邊巡邏。

entries.source: [[Overlord Ghorin]] has offered to sell food supplies to the Alliance.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[戈林霸主]]提議將糧食出售給聯盟。

entries.source: Be prepared to intercept any Imperial attacks.
entries.target_zh_TW: 準備攔截帝國軍的任何攻擊。

entries.source: [[Ghorin's ]]Freighters will deliver the grain to our Freighters here.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[戈林]]的貨船將在此處把穀物移交給我方貨船。

entries.source: With the clearing of the minefield we may proceed with the delivery of grain from [[Overlord Ghorin]].  Three of his Freighters are en route to meet three of ours.$  Two A-wings from [[Red]] Squadron will be sent ahead to maintain security at the rendezvous point.  This supply of grain will be enough to restore our stockpile and allow us to get back to our main purpose...$overthrowing the Empire!
entries.target_zh_TW: 雷區清除後，我們便可著手接收[[戈林霸主]]的穀物。他的三艘貨船正在前來與我方三艘貨船會合的途中。$  [[紅色]]中隊將先行派出兩架 A翼戰機，維護會合點的安全。這批穀物足以補足我們的存糧，讓我們重新回到主要目標……$推翻帝國！

entries.source: Be extremely alert, [[Overlord Ghorin]] is known to be ruthless and cunning. He may attempt to doublecross us and this could be a trap!  If this works out, though, we will have found a great new ally.$  The Freighters for both sides will arrive singly about [[five]] minutes apart. The first two will be arriving almost immediately after you do.  The cargo transfer process will take [[two]] minutes for each pair of Freighters.
entries.target_zh_TW: 務必提高警覺，[[戈林霸主]]以冷酷狡詐聞名。他可能企圖出賣我們，這也可能是個陷阱！不過，若事情順利，我們就多了一位強大的新盟友。$  雙方的貨船會逐一抵達，每艘間隔約[[五]]分鐘。前兩艘幾乎會在你抵達後立刻到達。每對貨船的貨物轉運需時[[兩]]分鐘。

entries.source: You will be attacked by several waves of GUNs and TRNs.  Watch for the TRNs especially because they launch torpedoes.  Save and use duel missiles on the later TRNs.$  You have two wingmen, use them wisely.  There will be 14 GUNs in two ship groups.  There will be 10 TRNs in four groups (2 of 2 and 2 of 3).
entries.target_zh_TW: 你會遭到數波砲艇和運輸艦的攻擊。特別留意運輸艦，因為它們會發射魚雷。保留飛彈，等後面幾波運輸艦出現時再以雙發模式發射。$  你有兩架僚機，善加運用。共有 14 艘砲艇，以兩艘為一組；共有 10 艘運輸艦，分成四組（兩組各 2 艘、兩組各 3 艘）。

entries.source:
Fly a reconnaissance
mission in your A-wing to 
verify the location of an
Imperial grain storage
facility.
entries.target_zh_TW:
駕駛 A翼戰機
執行偵察任務，
確認一座帝國
穀物儲存設施的
位置。

entries.source: A-wing [[Red]] is to confirm the reports of [[grain]] located at an Imperial depot.
entries.target_zh_TW: A翼[[紅色中隊]]要查證帝國補給站存有[[穀物]]的情報。

entries.source: If true the Freighter[[ Sarsuma ]]will come out of hyperspace to take it.
entries.target_zh_TW: 若情報屬實，貨船[[薩蘇瑪號]]將脫離超空間前來奪取。

entries.source: If there are enemy patrol craft in the area destroy them first!
entries.target_zh_TW: 若該區域有敵方巡邏艇，先將其摧毀！

entries.source: [[Ghorin]] has doublecrossed us!  The grain he sold us was very subtly tainted and would have sickened us all.  Fortunately, we rigorously tested it before distribution.  Without a new supply source we're worse off than before in our need for food.$  A small, lightly guarded Imperial storage area is rumored to have Cargo Containers full of grain.  If this is confirmed an Alliance Freighter will be sent to seize the grain.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[戈林]]出賣了我們！他賣給我們的穀物被極為隱密地下了毒，足以讓我們全體病倒。幸好我們在配發前做了嚴格檢驗。少了新的供應來源，我們的糧食需求比以前更加窘迫。$  據傳，一處守備薄弱的小型帝國儲存區裡有裝滿穀物的貨櫃。若此事屬實，聯盟將派出一艘貨船奪取這批穀物。

entries.source: You will fly your A-wing to this location to conduct an armed reconnaissance of the Imperial storage area.  Destroy any security patrols you encounter.$  Then determine if any of the Containers are loaded with grain.  If so the Freighter [[Sarsuma]] will arrive to retrieve the grain.$  Be prepared to ward off any Imperial counterattack, though this is a quiet sector and none is expected.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你將駕駛 A翼戰機前往此處，對帝國儲存區進行武裝偵察。摧毀遭遇的所有警戒巡邏隊。$  接著查明是否有貨櫃裝載穀物。若有，貨船[[薩蘇瑪號]]將會抵達取回穀物。$  做好擊退帝國反擊的準備，不過這是個平靜的星區，預計不會有反擊。

entries.source: Destroy all TIE Fighters first.  Then ID all CONs.  An Imperial FRT will arrive and drop off another CON.  This one contains the grain.  ID it to bring in the [[Sarsuma]].$  This will also bring in a Star Destroyer which will destroy the [[Sarsuma]].  Let it.  You will still get the mission complete message and may return to base.
entries.target_zh_TW: 先摧毀所有鈦戰機。接著識別所有貨櫃。一艘帝國貨船會抵達並卸下另一個貨櫃，這個貨櫃裝的就是穀物。識別它以引來[[薩蘇瑪號]]。$  這也會引來一艘滅星者，它會摧毀[[薩蘇瑪號]]。由它去吧。你仍會收到任務完成訊息，並可返回基地。

entries.source: We'll need to analyze your flight recorder data
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們需要分析你的飛行記錄器資料
俘獲戈林的 Y翼戰機

entries.source:
As part of a master
plan to seek revenge on
Ghorin for his treachery
against the Alliance, steal
a group of his Y-wings.
entries.target_zh_TW:
作為向戈林
報復其背叛聯盟
之總體計畫的
一環，竊取他的
一批 Y翼戰機。
>任務 11：俘獲戈林的 Y翼戰機

entries.source: The first part of the plan requires that we capture a number of [[Ghorin's]] Y-wings.  These escorts, therefore, are the target.$  [[Red One]] will lead the raid with two Y-wings.  As you disable the enemy ships, our Commando units will arrive to capture them.  The Alliance Cruiser [[Maria]] will arrive in less than [[seven]] minutes to receive the captured ships.
entries.target_zh_TW: 計畫的第一步，是俘獲一批[[戈林]]的 Y翼戰機。因此，這些護航機就是目標。$  [[紅色一號]]將率領兩架 Y翼戰機發動突襲。在你癱瘓敵機的同時，我方突擊隊會抵達並將其俘獲。聯盟巡洋艦[[瑪莉亞號]]將在不到[[七]]分鐘內抵達，接收俘獲的戰機。

entries.source: Y-wing [[Red]] will take a position near this hyperspace transit point.
entries.target_zh_TW: Y翼[[紅色中隊]]將在這處超空間轉運點附近就位。

entries.source: [[Ghorin's]] Corvette [[Halifax]] will arrive with six escorting Y-wings.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[戈林]]的護衛艦[[哈利法克斯號]]將在六架 Y翼戰機護航下抵達。

entries.source: Disable as many of [[Ghorin's]] Y-wings as you can so they may be captured.
entries.target_zh_TW: 盡可能癱瘓[[戈林]]的 Y翼戰機，以便俘獲。

entries.source: The [[Halifax]] will be disabled so that its cargo may be confiscated.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[哈利法克斯號]]將被癱瘓，以便沒收艦上貨物。

entries.source: The Alliance Cruiser [[Maria]] will enter to receive the captured Y-wings.
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟巡洋艦[[瑪莉亞號]]將進入戰區，接收俘獲的 Y翼戰機。

entries.source: Alliance High Command has devised a plan to avenge [[Overlord Ghorin's]] doublecross.  We will execute a series of operations to convince the Empire that it is the [[Emperor]] who is being doublecrossed, not us!$  As we were receiving the tainted grain a regular shipment to the Empire had been arranged, also.  The payment for this is being brought back on the Corvette [[Halifax]].  [[Ghorin]] has sent six Y-wings as escort.$
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟最高指揮部已擬定計畫，要報復[[戈林霸主]]的背叛。我們將執行一系列行動，讓帝國相信遭到出賣的是[[皇帝]]，而不是我們！$  在我們接收有毒穀物的同時，另一批運往帝國的例行貨運也已安排妥當。這批貨的貨款正由護衛艦[[哈利法克斯號]]運回。[[戈林]]派了六架 Y翼戰機護航。$

entries.source: Commandos will come in to capture the Y-wings and board the [[Halifax]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 突擊隊將進場俘獲 Y翼戰機，並登上[[哈利法克斯號]]。

entries.source: After the cargo has been seized [[Red One]] will destroy the Corvette.
entries.target_zh_TW: 貨物奪取後，[[紅色一號]]將摧毀這艘護衛艦。

entries.source: As a bonus we will confiscate the Empire's payment to [[Ghorin]].  This will serve as an appropriate "refund" for the bad grain sold to us.  The [[Halifax]] can not be crewed at this time and so will be destroyed.$  Move quickly as we wish to avoid detection by Imperial forces.  Watch over the recovery operation and then follow the [[Maria]] out.$  Remember that Y-wings can survive a single torpedo so use them!
entries.target_zh_TW: 額外的收穫是，我們將沒收帝國付給[[戈林]]的貨款，正好當作他賣給我們劣質穀物的「退款」。[[哈利法克斯號]]目前無法派員接管，因此將予以摧毀。$  動作要快，我們要避免被帝國軍發現。監護回收行動，然後跟隨[[瑪莉亞號]]撤離。$  記住，Y翼戰機挨一枚魚雷還撐得住，所以儘管用！

entries.source: To avoid detection by the Empire our forces must move quickly.
entries.target_zh_TW: 為避免被帝國發現，我方部隊必須迅速行動。

entries.source: First fire four torpedoes at the [[Halifax]] and then disable it as quickly as possible.$   Each pair of Y-wings has a corresponding pair of SHUs.  Since both SHUs will arrive as soon as one Y-wing is disabled, try to disable the Y-wings in pairs.$   Note that a Y-wing can survive a single torpedo hit, and will then be very easy to disable.  This way you can get them as quickly as possible.
entries.target_zh_TW: 先對[[哈利法克斯號]]發射四枚魚雷，然後盡快將它癱瘓。$   每一對 Y翼戰機都對應一對穿梭機。只要有一架 Y翼戰機被癱瘓，兩艘穿梭機就會同時抵達，所以盡量成對癱瘓 Y翼戰機。$   注意，Y翼戰機挨一枚魚雷還撐得住，之後就非常容易癱瘓。這樣你就能以最快速度拿下它們。

entries.source: GHORIN'S Y-WINGS ARE GOING TO BE PUT TO GOOD USE NOW!
entries.target_zh_TW: 戈林的 Y翼戰機現在要派上用場了！

entries.source: THE IMPERIAL CREDITS WE SEIZED WILL BE OF USE, TOO
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們奪得的帝國信用點也會很有用

entries.source:
In your X-wing attack
an Imperial storage area
and destroy an important
set of grain containers.
entries.target_zh_TW:
駕駛 X翼戰機
攻擊帝國儲存區，
摧毀一批重要的
穀物貨櫃。

entries.source: We will keep up our attacks on the Empire's food supplies.  This time the target is a supply storage area in the [[Hollan D1]] sector.  This vital depot supplies this entire sector.$  We will use the Y-wings we captured from [[Ghorin]].  Our plan is to cause the Empire to believe that [[Ghorin]] is doublecrossing them.  Also, this attack will make the Empire's forces in this sector as desperate for food as we are!
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們將繼續攻擊帝國的糧食補給。這次的目標是[[霍蘭 D1]] 星區的一處補給儲存區。這座重要的補給站供應整個星區。$  我們將使用從[[戈林]]那裡俘獲的 Y翼戰機。我們的計畫是讓帝國相信[[戈林]]正在出賣他們。此外，這次攻擊也會讓帝國在此星區的部隊和我們一樣陷入糧荒！

entries.source: An Imperial Storage Area in the [[Hollan D1]] sector must be eliminated.
entries.target_zh_TW: 必須摧毀[[霍蘭 D1]] 星區的一處帝國儲存區。

entries.source: All Imperial Grain[[ ]]Containers must be destroyed.
entries.target_zh_TW: 所有帝國穀物[[ ]]貨櫃都必須摧毀。

entries.source: X-wing [[Red]] will also be responsible for destroying any mines and satellites.
entries.target_zh_TW: X翼[[紅色中隊]]也負責摧毀所有水雷和衛星。

entries.source: You will also destroy any other craft encountered such as TRNs or SHUs.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你還要摧毀遭遇的其他艦艇，例如運輸艦或穿梭機。

entries.source: Y-wing [[Blue]] will lead the attack with X-wing [[Red]] providing escort.
entries.target_zh_TW: Y翼[[藍色中隊]]將打頭陣，X翼[[紅色中隊]]負責護航。

entries.source: The Calamari Cruiser [[Cathleen]] will arrive to engage the Imperial Frigate.
entries.target_zh_TW: 卡拉馬里巡洋艦[[凱瑟琳號]]將抵達並與帝國巡防艦交戰。

entries.source: Intercept any counterattacks by Imperial starfighters.
entries.target_zh_TW: 攔截帝國星際戰機的任何反擊。

entries.source: Alliance Intelligence indicates that the Imperial Frigate [[Sentinel]] is at the depot.  The Alliance Cruiser [[Cathleen]] will arrive to attack the Frigate one minute after [[Red]] arrives.  It is likely that the Frigate will flee.  If so, the [[Cathleen]] will pursue.$  You and your wingman will escort the three Y-wings in this attack.  Stay alert and be prepared for Imperial counterattacks.
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟情報部指出，帝國巡防艦[[哨兵號]]正停駐在補給站。聯盟巡洋艦[[凱瑟琳號]]將在[[紅色中隊]]抵達一分鐘後前來攻擊這艘巡防艦。巡防艦很可能會逃離；若是如此，[[凱瑟琳號]]將會追擊。$  你和你的僚機將護送三架 Y翼戰機執行這次攻擊。保持警覺，準備應對帝國軍的反擊。

entries.source: All CONs and FRTs must be destroyed.  There are two FRTs ready to leave seconds after mission start.  Close in fast and order wingman to attack the lead FRT.  Fire two torpedoes at it yourself.$  You will be attacked by 4 SHUs and then 4 T/As.  Kill the SHUs and evade the T/As.  GUNs will enter and attack you, also.  A 3rd FRT will enter at [[5]] minutes into the mission.  Use your remaining six torpedoes on it.
entries.target_zh_TW: 所有貨櫃和貨船都必須摧毀。任務開始數秒後，就有兩艘貨船準備離開。迅速逼近，命令僚機攻擊領頭的貨船，你自己也對它發射兩枚魚雷。$  你會先遭到 4 艘穿梭機攻擊，接著是 4 架鈦先進型戰機。擊殺穿梭機，閃避鈦先進型戰機。砲艇也會進場攻擊你。第 3 艘貨船會在任務開始後 [[5]] 分鐘進場，把剩下的六枚魚雷都用在它身上。

entries.source: Be sure not to let any Imperial Freighters escape from the area.
entries.target_zh_TW: 務必不讓任何帝國貨船逃離此區域。

entries.source: THE STORAGE AREA IS NO LONGER OPERATIONAL
WE HAVE DESTROYED THIS SECTOR'S FOOD SUPPLIES
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們摧毀了這個星區的糧食補給

entries.source: THE EMPEROR WILL BELIEVE GHORIN HAS BETRAYED HIM!
entries.target_zh_TW: 皇帝會以為戈林背叛了他！

entries.source:
Attack and destroy an
Imperial convoy of 
Corvettes carrying an
important grain shipment.
entries.target_zh_TW:
攻擊並摧毀
一支載運重要
穀物貨物的帝國
護衛艦船團。

entries.source: We will continue to attack Imperial food supplies.  This strike will be against a convoy of several Corvettes bound for the [[Geedon]] system.$  As part of our plan to discredit [[Overlord Ghorin]] we will use some of the Y-wings you helped capture.  This should make it appear that he has betrayed the Emperor.  It will also disrupt Imperial operations as they are forced to search for food.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們將繼續攻擊帝國的糧食補給。這次的打擊目標是一支由數艘護衛艦組成、正駛往[[吉頓]]星系的船團。$  作為抹黑[[戈林霸主]]計畫的一環，我們將使用你協助俘獲的部分 Y翼戰機。這應該能讓他看起來像是背叛了皇帝，也會打亂帝國的作戰，迫使他們四處尋找糧食。

entries.source: Five captured Y-wings will be used to completely destroy this food convoy.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們將動用五架俘獲的 Y翼戰機，徹底摧毀這支糧食船團。

entries.source: A convoy of Imperial Corvettes is headed for the [[Geedon]] system.
entries.target_zh_TW: 一支帝國護衛艦船團正駛往[[吉頓]]星系。

entries.source: [[Red ]]Squadron will provide two X-wings to escort the attacking Y-wings.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色]]中隊將派出兩架 X翼戰機，護送發動攻擊的 Y翼戰機。

entries.source: You and your wingman will escort the captured Y-wings.  Use your torpedoes to assist, but be prepared to break off and intercept any Imperial reinforcements.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你和你的僚機將護送俘獲的 Y翼戰機。用你的魚雷協助攻擊，但要隨時準備脫離，攔截帝國援軍。

entries.source: Don't worry about the Y-Ws too much, and save your torps for any CRVs that are left after all the Y-Ws are destroyed.  You will have to finish off any remaining CRVs.$  Remember CRVs have a blind spot.  The safest way to approach a CRV is dead level from the rear.  Their engine exhausts should appear perfectly square as you close in.  Note which lasers are firing at you, top or bottom, and adjust.
entries.target_zh_TW: 不必太擔心那些 Y翼戰機，把魚雷留給所有 Y翼戰機都被摧毀後還剩下的護衛艦。剩下的護衛艦得由你收拾。$  記住，護衛艦有射擊死角。接近護衛艦最安全的方式，是從正後方保持水平高度接近。逼近時，它的引擎噴口看起來應該呈正方形。留意是上方還是下方的雷射砲在對你開火，並隨之調整。

entries.source: The Imperial Convoy has been destroyed
THE EMPIRE SHOULD SOON FEEL THE LOSS OF ITS FOOD SUPPLIES
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國很快就會感受到失去糧食補給的痛

entries.source: THE EMPEROR WILL BE CONVINCED OF GHORIN'S TREACHERY NOW
entries.target_zh_TW: 這下皇帝會深信戈林背叛了他

entries.source:
Fly a Y-wing to ambush
an Imperial grain convoy
and swap cargoes with our
Freighters.
entries.target_zh_TW:
駕駛 Y翼戰機
伏擊帝國穀物船團，
並與我方貨船
調換貨物。

entries.source: Y-wing groups [[Red]] and[[ Gold]] will ambush the grain convoy here.
entries.target_zh_TW: Y翼[[紅色]]與[[金色]]編隊將在此伏擊穀物船團。

entries.source: The convoy consists of two Freighters and several smaller vessels.
entries.target_zh_TW: 船團由兩艘貨船和數艘較小的船艦組成。

entries.source: [[Gold]] will disable the Freighters while [[Red]] disables the rest of the ships.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[金色]]編隊負責癱瘓貨船，[[紅色]]編隊負責癱瘓其餘船艦。

entries.source: Our Commandos will then come in to board them and replace the crews.
entries.target_zh_TW: 接著我方突擊隊會進場登艦，替換船員。

entries.source: As the Freighters are disabled ours will come in to exchange cargos.
entries.target_zh_TW: 貨船被癱瘓後，我方貨船會進場調換貨物。

entries.source: All our vessels must evacuate the area before Imperial ships arrive.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我方所有船艦都必須在帝國艦艇抵達前撤離此區域。

entries.source: This operation is the final step in our plan to discredit [[Ghorin]].  This grain convoy is en route to an Imperial base.  We will stop it and substitute crews and cargo.$  All vessels in the convoy must be disabled as quickly as possible.  Their ships will then be boarded and their crews replaced.  The grain will be exchanged with the poisoned grain we were sold.  We will then evacuate before Imperial forces can respond.
entries.target_zh_TW: 這次行動是我們抹黑[[戈林]]計畫的最後一步。這支穀物船團正駛往一座帝國基地。我們將攔下它，替換船員和貨物。$  船團中的所有船艦都必須盡快癱瘓。接著我們會登上這些船，替換船員，並把穀物調換成賣給我們的有毒穀物。然後在帝國軍做出反應前撤離。

entries.source: The replacement crews will claim to have driven off the "pirate" attack.  It is absolutely essential that no Alliance ships be detected by Imperial forces.$  Destroy any escorting fighters as quickly as you can.$  Time is critical, so fire a few torpedoes into each of the Freighters to assist Y-wing [[Gold ]]as they disable them.$
entries.target_zh_TW: 替換上去的船員會宣稱他們擊退了「海盜」的攻擊。絕對不能讓帝國軍發現任何聯盟船艦。$  盡快摧毀所有護航戰機。$  時間緊迫，所以對每艘貨船發射幾枚魚雷，協助 Y翼[[金色]]編隊癱瘓它們。$

entries.source: [[Red One]] will be responsible for eliminating the Y-wing escorts.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色一號]]負責消滅護航的 Y翼戰機。

entries.source: If the enemy FRTs are escaping try putting a few torpedoes in them to aid Y-W [[Gold]].  Do this as early as you can.$   You may find yourself having to disable almost everything, (including the FRTs) as your wingman are not very effective.$   The Imperials will arrive [[13]] minutes after mission start. The Rebel FRTs must have completed docking before this to escape in time.
entries.target_zh_TW: 如果敵方貨船正在逃脫，試著對它們發射幾枚魚雷，協助 Y翼[[金色]]編隊。越早動手越好。$   你可能會發現幾乎所有目標（包括貨船）都得由你親自癱瘓，因為你的僚機不太中用。$   帝國軍會在任務開始後 [[13]] 分鐘抵達。反抗軍貨船必須在此之前完成對接，才能及時脫身。

entries.source: GREAT WORK, GHORIN'S HAD IT NOW!
entries.target_zh_TW: 幹得好，戈林這下完蛋了！

entries.source: THE IMPERIALS WILL BE TOLD WE WERE SCARED AWAY
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國軍會聽說我們被嚇跑了

entries.source:
Confirm delivery to the
Empire of the grain 
shipment that has been
poisoned by Ghorin.
entries.target_zh_TW:
確認那批遭戈林
下毒的穀物
已經送到
帝國手中。

entries.source: Do not engage the Transports!  Defend yourself only if attacked.
entries.target_zh_TW: 不要攻擊運輸艦！只有遭到攻擊時才自衛。

entries.source: The Imperial Frigate [[Elite]] is expecting its food supplies to arrive shortly.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國巡防艦[[精銳號]]正等待即將送達的糧食補給。

entries.source: The [[Elite's]] starfighters are reported to include the new TIE Advanced.
entries.target_zh_TW: 據報，[[精銳號]]的星際戰機中包括新型的鈦先進型戰機。

entries.source: A-wing [[Red]] must ID each TRN until a cargo of tainted grain is confirmed.
entries.target_zh_TW: A翼[[紅色中隊]]必須逐一識別運輸艦，直到確認找到有毒穀物為止。

entries.source: You will need to stay close to the [[Elite]] so no supply ships can slip by.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你必須待在[[精銳號]]附近，不讓任何補給船溜過。

entries.source: The grain exchange operation was successful.  Now [[High Command]] wants to confirm that the tainted grain is being distributed to Imperial forces.   A Nebulon B stationed in the [[Droma]] sector is waiting for a supply shipment. [[ Red]] Squadron will send three A-wings to identify any Transports entering that area.  All that is needed is to confirm delivery of the tainted grain.$  Do not engage the Transports!
entries.target_zh_TW: 穀物調換行動成功了。現在[[最高指揮部]]想確認有毒穀物正被配發給帝國部隊。一艘駐紮在[[卓瑪]]星區的星雲B型巡防艦正在等待一批補給。[[紅色]]中隊將派出三架 A翼戰機，識別進入該區域的所有運輸艦。只需確認有毒穀物已經送達即可。$  不要攻擊運輸艦！

entries.source: This Frigate, the [[Elite]], is reported to have the new Advanced TIE Fighter among its starfighter complement.  Defend yourself if attacked but concentrate on identifying the Transports as they arrive.
entries.target_zh_TW: 據報，這艘巡防艦[[精銳號]]的星際戰機編制中有新型的鈦先進型戰機。遭到攻擊時可以自衛，但要專心在運輸艦抵達時進行識別。

entries.source: There is only one TRN carrying grain.  It is number 2 in a 3 ship group that enters [[6:18]] minutes after mission start.  All enemy fighters increase in skill level with each new wave of each type.$  Beware of the T/As, the first one is a Novice and may collide with you.  Use your wingmen to gang up on a single T/A at a time.  (Their shields regenerate quickly.)  Use missiles on T/Bs; don't waste them on T/As.
entries.target_zh_TW: 只有一艘運輸艦載有穀物。它是任務開始 [[6:18]] 後進場的 3 艘編隊中的第 2 艘。每種敵機的每一新波次，技術等級都會提升。$  小心鈦先進型戰機，第一架是新手，可能會撞上你。運用你的僚機，一次圍攻一架鈦先進型戰機。（它們的護盾回復得很快。）把飛彈用在鈦轟炸機上，別浪費在鈦先進型戰機身上。

entries.source: YOU HAVE CONFIRMED THE DISTRIBUTION OF THE TAINTED GRAIN
entries.target_zh_TW: 你已確認有毒穀物正在配發

entries.source: IMPERIAL FORCES SHOULD SOON SUFFER THE ILL EFFECTS
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國部隊很快就會嘗到苦果

entries.source: THANKS, RED ONE, THAT WAS SOME GREAT FIGHTING!
entries.target_zh_TW: 謝了，紅色一號，打得真漂亮！

entries.source:
Attack Imperial research
and development site and
capture the TIE Advanced
spacecraft that are being
built there.
entries.target_zh_TW:
攻擊帝國研發基地，
俘獲在那裡
建造中的
鈦先進型
戰機。

entries.source: A-wing [[Red]] will lead the raid.  [[Red One]] will be responsible for clearing the minefield.  The others will take out the arriving Shuttle and the upper level of the facility.$  The mission has been planned to take advantage of a crew shift change.  Nevertheless, be prepared to face stiff opposition.  This is a very valuable asset to the Empire and they can be counted on to respond quickly!
entries.target_zh_TW: A翼[[紅色中隊]]將率領這次突襲。[[紅色一號]]負責清除雷區，其他人負責解決抵達的穿梭機以及設施的上層。$  這次任務刻意安排在敵方換班時發動。儘管如此，仍要準備面對頑強抵抗。這座設施對帝國極具價值，他們必定會迅速回應！

entries.source: [[Advanced TIE Fighters]] are being tested at a secret location.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[鈦先進型戰機]]正在一處秘密地點進行測試。

entries.source: A-wing [[Red]] must intercept the Shuttle arriving with the new pilots.
entries.target_zh_TW: A翼[[紅色中隊]]必須攔截載著新飛行員抵達的穿梭機。

entries.source: Our attack has been timed to hit during a routine staff rotation.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們的攻擊時機刻意安排在例行人員輪替期間。

entries.source: Then clear the minefield and destroy the upper Containers of the facility.
entries.target_zh_TW: 接著清除雷區，並摧毀設施上層的貨櫃。

entries.source: The facility is surrounded by a protective layer of mines.
entries.target_zh_TW: 設施周圍布有一層防護水雷。

entries.source: Freighter [[Ashanti]] will then arrive to dock with one of the Fighter sheds.
entries.target_zh_TW: 接著貨船[[阿散蒂號]]會抵達，與其中一座戰機棚對接。

entries.source: A-wing [[Red]] will patrol the area while the operation proceeds.
entries.target_zh_TW: 行動進行期間，A翼[[紅色中隊]]將在此區域巡邏。

entries.source: Alliance Intelligence has discovered a secret Imperial base where the new [[TIE Advanced]] is being tested and new pilots trained. This new starfighter was first observed during the [[Battle of Yavin]].  More recently it was observed during an armed reconnaissance in the [[Droma ]]Sector.  Not only is it faster than our A-wing, it has shields as well!  We must acquire examples of this fighter so that we may study it.
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟情報部發現了一座帝國秘密基地，新型的[[鈦先進型戰機]]正在那裡進行測試，並訓練新飛行員。這款新型星際戰機首次出現於[[雅文戰役]]，最近一次則是在[[卓瑪]]星區的一次武裝偵察中被發現。它不僅比我們的 A翼戰機更快，還配有護盾！我們必須取得這款戰機的樣本加以研究。

entries.source: Your wingmen will take out the SHU and upper CONs.  Only two T/As are active and dangerous.  The others are stationary with their shields down.$  Respond quickly to the incoming GUNs, but save at least 8 missiles for the pair of CRVs and TRN that come in later.  Use your remaining missiles on one CRV.  Then take out the TRN ASAP (order your wingmen to help.)  Finish off the weakened CRV then blindside the other.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你的僚機將負責解決穿梭機和上層的貨櫃。只有兩架鈦先進型戰機處於活動狀態，具有威脅；其餘的都靜止不動，護盾也已關閉。$  迅速應對來襲的砲艇，但至少保留 8 枚飛彈，對付稍後進場的兩艘護衛艦和運輸艦。把剩下的飛彈用在其中一艘護衛艦上。接著盡快解決運輸艦（命令你的僚機協助）。收拾掉受損的護衛艦，再從死角突襲另一艘。

entries.source: WE'LL DELIVER THESE ADVANCED TIES TO OUR SCIENTISTS FOR STUDY
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們會把這些鈦先進型戰機交給科學家研究

entries.source:
Protect Alliance convoy 
of Freighters and Corvettes
as they try to avoid
destruction by Imperial
forces.
entries.target_zh_TW:
保護由貨船與
護衛艦組成的聯盟
船團，助其躲避
帝國部隊的
摧毀。

entries.source: Two A-wings from [[Red]] Squadron will patrol the area between the two Nav Buoys.  Stay alert and be prepared to ward off any Imperial attacks.$  The three groups are [[five]] minutes apart.  Each will take about [[thirteen]] minutes to reach the next jump point.$  All of these ships carry critical supplies so we can't afford to lose even one of them.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色]]中隊的兩架 A翼戰機將在兩座導航浮標之間的區域巡邏。保持警覺，準備擊退帝國軍的任何攻擊。$  三組船隊彼此間隔[[五]]分鐘。每組約需[[十三]]分鐘抵達下一個躍遷點。$  這些船艦全都載有關鍵物資，我們連一艘都損失不起。

entries.source: An Alliance convoy of Freighters and Corvettes will arrive in three groups.
entries.target_zh_TW: 一支由貨船與護衛艦組成的聯盟船團將分三組抵達。

entries.source: First attack is by 4 GUNs with 2 following waves. The FRG arrives 7:18 into the mission.  It launches one sqdn of T/Bs and one sqdn of T/Is. (Two groups of two ships each for both types with 3 following waves.)$  Destroy all GUNs as quickly as you can.  The FRG arrives about 20 klicks away so finish off the GUNs and then go after the T/Bs.  Evade the T/Is until all T/Bs are gone.
entries.target_zh_TW: 第一波攻擊來自 4 艘砲艇，隨後還有 2 波。巡防艦會在任務開始 7:18 時抵達，並放出一個中隊的鈦轟炸機和一個中隊的鈦攔截機。（兩種機型都是兩組各兩架，之後各有 3 波增援。）$  盡快摧毀所有砲艇。巡防艦會在約 20 公里外出現，所以先解決砲艇，再去追擊鈦轟炸機。在所有鈦轟炸機被消滅前，先閃避鈦攔截機。

entries.source: A-wing [[Red]] will patrol at this hyperspace transfer point.
entries.target_zh_TW: A翼[[紅色中隊]]將在這處超空間轉運點巡邏。

entries.source: Each group will consist of a Freighter and two Corvettes.
entries.target_zh_TW: 每組由一艘貨船和兩艘護衛艦組成。

entries.source: The convoy is critical as it has all the supplies to establish a new base.
entries.target_zh_TW: 這支船團至關重要，因為它載有建立新基地所需的全部物資。

entries.source: The Alliance continues to search for a good location to rebuild our secret base.  This convoy of Freighters and Corvettes carry vital supplies and personnel from the base we abandoned on [[Yavin]].$  This is everything we need to establish a new base as soon as a suitable location can be found.  In the meantime we continue to evade the Empire in a deadly game of hide and seek.
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟仍在尋找合適的地點重建秘密基地。這支由貨船與護衛艦組成的船團，載運著從我們撤離的[[雅文]]基地帶出的重要物資與人員。$  一旦找到合適的地點，這就是我們建立新基地所需的一切。在此之前，我們仍要與帝國玩一場致命的捉迷藏。

entries.source: WELL DONE, RED TWO.  THE CONVOY IS SAFE
entries.target_zh_TW: 做得好，紅色二號。船團已經安全

entries.source: HEAD HOME FOR YOUR NEXT ASSIGNMENT

Protect neutral supply
convoy in an attempt to win
their support for the Rebel
Alliance.
entries.target_zh_TW:
保護中立的
補給船團，以爭取
他們對反抗軍聯盟的
支持。

entries.source: The [[Leafar]] are ready to join the Alliance and want our protection.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[利法爾人]]已準備加入聯盟，並希望得到我們的保護。

entries.source: Patrol this busy hyperspace transit area and intercept any threat.
entries.target_zh_TW: 在這片繁忙的超空間轉運區巡邏，攔截任何威脅。

entries.source: Proof is needed of our ability to offer protection to members of the Alliance.  The [[Leafar]] have begun to challenge the Empire and are certain to face retribution.  Alliance forces are therefore being sent to protect an important transfer point near their system.$  If we can protect their shipping from Imperial attack we will have gained a new ally.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們需要證明自己有能力保護聯盟的成員。[[利法爾人]]已開始挑戰帝國，必定會遭到報復。因此，聯盟正派遣部隊保護他們星系附近的一處重要轉運點。$  只要能保護他們的船運免受帝國攻擊，我們就能贏得一位新盟友。

entries.source: Order your wingmen to attack the T/As while you concentrate on the T/Bs.  Don't let any Bombers sneak past you.$  Ignore any T/As that attack you until all Bombers are destroyed.$  As soon as 3 CRVs, 2 FRTs and 4 SHUs make it into hyperspace you will get the mission complete message.
entries.target_zh_TW: 命令你的僚機攻擊鈦先進型戰機，你則專心對付鈦轟炸機。別讓任何轟炸機從你身邊溜過。$  在所有轟炸機被摧毀前，不要理會攻擊你的鈦先進型戰機。$  只要有 3 艘護衛艦、2 艘貨船和 4 艘穿梭機進入超空間，你就會收到任務完成訊息。

entries.source: There will be a series of Freighters, Corvettes and Shuttles.
entries.target_zh_TW: 將會有一連串的貨船、護衛艦和穿梭機經過。

entries.source: The Task Force led by CRS [[Maria]] will respond to any large scale attack.
entries.target_zh_TW: 由巡洋艦[[瑪莉亞號]]率領的特遣隊將應對任何大規模攻擊。

entries.source: Hold out until relieved.  A-W [[Gold]] is also near and may come to your aid.
entries.target_zh_TW: 堅守到援軍接替為止。A翼[[金色中隊]]也在附近，可能會前來支援。

entries.source: You will lead a five ship group of X-wings from[[ Red]] Squadron.  Stay near the transfer point and be prepared to intercept any Imperial threat.$  An Alliance Task Force led by the Cruiser [[Maria]] and the Frigate [[Whitehawk]] is in this sector and will reinforce in case of a large scale attack by the Empire.$  You must ensure that as many merchant ships as possible survive.
entries.target_zh_TW: 你將率領[[紅色]]中隊的五架 X翼戰機。待在轉運點附近，準備攔截帝國的任何威脅。$  一支由巡洋艦[[瑪莉亞號]]與巡防艦[[白鷹號]]率領的聯盟特遣隊正在此星區，若帝國發動大規模攻擊，將前來增援。$  你必須確保盡可能多的商船存活下來。

entries.source: WELL DONE, RED ONE, WE'LL TAKE OVER FROM HERE
entries.target_zh_TW: 做得好，紅色一號，接下來交給我們

entries.source:
Escort Alliance Corvettes
in their attack and destroy
mission against the Imperial
Frigate Red Wind.
entries.target_zh_TW:
護航聯盟護衛艦，
執行攻擊並摧毀
帝國巡防艦
赤風號的任務。

entries.source: Alliance Corvettes will conduct a revenge run against this Frigate.
entries.target_zh_TW: 聯盟護衛艦將對這艘巡防艦發動復仇攻擊。

entries.source: A-wing [[Red]] will fly point in this attack to clear the mines and any fighters.
entries.target_zh_TW: A翼[[紅色中隊]]將擔任這次攻擊的先鋒，清除水雷和所有戰機。

entries.source: The assault run will be made in three waves of three Corvettes.
entries.target_zh_TW: 攻擊將分三波進行，每波三艘護衛艦。

entries.source: The infamous Imperial Frigate [[Red Wind]] has been located near [[Plooriod IV]].  A small minefield has been placed around it suggesting it is immobile and may be undergoing repairs.$  The [[Red Wind's]] commander is one of the most ruthless and has been involved in numerous atrocities.  Several Corvette crews have demanded we make this revenge attack.
entries.target_zh_TW: 惡名昭彰的帝國巡防艦[[赤風號]]已在[[普魯里奧德四號星]]附近被發現。它周圍布有一小片雷區，顯示它無法移動，可能正在進行維修。$  [[赤風號]]的艦長是最冷酷無情的指揮官之一，曾參與多起暴行。數艘護衛艦的船員要求我們發動這次復仇攻擊。

entries.source: The Imperial Frigate [[Red Wind ]]has been identified near [[Plooriod IV]].
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國巡防艦[[赤風號]]已在[[普魯里奧德四號星]]附近被識別出來。

entries.source: It appears to be undergoing repairs and has a small minefield around it.
entries.target_zh_TW: 它似乎正在進行維修，周圍布有一小片雷區。

entries.source: The strike force will consist of nine Corvettes.  They will attack in three waves of three ships each.$  [[Red]] Squadron will send two A-wings ahead of the first wave to clear the minefield and intercept any Imperial starfighters.  You will remain in the area throughout the entire assault.
entries.target_zh_TW: 打擊部隊將由九艘護衛艦組成，分三波進攻，每波三艘。$  [[紅色]]中隊將派出兩架 A翼戰機在第一波之前先行，清除雷區並攔截任何帝國星際戰機。整個攻擊期間你都要留在此區域。

entries.source: Do not shoot the container. Ignore the two FRTs, TRN and SHU.  Primary concerns are the T/Bs and their torpedos.  Use your wingman wisely.$  Once the CRVs get close to the FRG, take out the mines.  You may have to do a little damage to the FRG yourself.  Hit it with lasers when in range waiting for the next wave to launch.  You may try firing all twelve missiles at the [[Red Wind]] during the first wave.
entries.target_zh_TW: 不要射擊貨櫃。不必理會那兩艘貨船、運輸艦和穿梭機。首要威脅是鈦轟炸機和它們的魚雷。善加運用你的僚機。$  護衛艦一接近巡防艦，就清除水雷。你可能得親自對巡防艦造成一些傷害：等待下一波進場時，只要在射程內就用雷射砲攻擊它。你也可以試著在第一波期間，把全部十二枚飛彈都射向[[赤風號]]。
又解決一艘帝國巡防艦！
這應該能提振聯盟的士氣！

entries.source:
Capture Imperial
Assault Gunboats in 
preparation for attacking
secret research site.
entries.target_zh_TW:
俘獲帝國
突擊砲艇，
為攻擊秘密
研究基地做準備。

entries.source: Y-wing[[ Red]] will lead the raid.  First, eliminate all Imperial defenses.
entries.target_zh_TW: Y翼[[紅色中隊]]將率領這次突襲。首先，消滅帝國的所有防禦。

entries.source: Then locate and disable any Gunboats in the area.
entries.target_zh_TW: 接著找出並癱瘓此區域內的所有砲艇。

entries.source: Shuttle group [[Leary]] will deliver the Commando teams to the Gunboats.
entries.target_zh_TW: 穿梭機編隊[[李瑞]]將把突擊小組送到砲艇上。

entries.source: After the Gunboats are captured the Cruiser [[Cathleen]] will arrive.
entries.target_zh_TW: 砲艇被俘獲後，巡洋艦[[凱瑟琳號]]將會抵達。

entries.source: After the Gunboats are recovered you can finish off the outpost.
entries.target_zh_TW: 砲艇回收後，你就可以徹底摧毀這座前哨站。

entries.source: We only need three Gunboats, and there are usually at least this many on station at these bases.  In addition, there are typically at least two or three Corvettes defending the base.$  [[Red]] Squadron will send two Y-wings in to eliminate the base's defenses and disable the Gunboats.  Shuttles will deliver capture teams and the Cruiser [[Cathleen]] will recover them.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們只需要三艘砲艇，而這類基地通常至少都駐有這個數量。此外，基地通常還有至少兩到三艘護衛艦防守。$  [[紅色]]中隊將派兩架 Y翼戰機進場，消滅基地的防禦並癱瘓砲艇。穿梭機會送來俘獲小組，巡洋艦[[凱瑟琳號]]則負責回收砲艇。

entries.source: Analysis of the Advanced TIE Fighters we captured proves that the Empire has developed a new shield technology.  Information received from the [[Leafar]] suggest this technology is being developed further for larger vessels.$  A Corellian Corvette is reportedly next to be equipped with this new technology.  The development site is "hidden in plain sight" at a Force Escort system outpost.
entries.target_zh_TW: 分析我們俘獲的鈦先進型戰機後證實，帝國已研發出一種新的護盾技術。[[利法爾人]]提供的情報顯示，這項技術正被進一步發展，以用於較大型的艦艇。$  據報，下一艘將裝備這項新技術的是一艘柯瑞利亞護衛艦。研發基地就「大剌剌地藏在眾目睽睽之下」，設在一座星系護航部隊的前哨站。

entries.source: These outposts serve as small bases for System Patrol Squadrons of Assault Gunboats and Corvettes.$  The plan to raid the development site will require the use of some captured Imperial Gunboats.  These will be used in a Trojan Horse style gambit to get in close to the test Corvette.  We intend to capture this ship intact for use in a major surprise attack Alliance Command is planning.
entries.target_zh_TW: 這些前哨站是由突擊砲艇和護衛艦組成的星系巡邏中隊的小型基地。$  突襲研發基地的計畫需要動用幾艘俘獲的帝國砲艇。我們將以特洛伊木馬式的計謀，利用它們接近測試中的護衛艦。我們打算完整俘獲這艘船，用於聯盟指揮部正在策劃的一場大規模突襲。

entries.source: A System Patrol Squadron's base is to be raided to capture Gunboats.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們將突襲一座星系巡邏中隊的基地以俘獲砲艇。

entries.source: Do a circle while you charge up and cycle ships through the CMD. Fire six tropedoes at one CRV and two at another on your way in. Order wingman to help you attack same CRV. The third CRV now has a unprotected blind spot (dead level).$  Keep an eye on the T/Bs.  Watch for the three Imperial SHUs that come in just after the Alliance SHUs.  Do not attack the CONs until after the "MISSION COMPLETE" message.
entries.target_zh_TW: 一邊繞圈充能，一邊在 CMD 上切換目標。進場時對一艘護衛艦發射六枚魚雷，再對另一艘發射兩枚。命令僚機協助你攻擊同一艘護衛艦。這時第三艘護衛艦就會露出毫無防護的死角（保持水平高度）。$  留意鈦轟炸機。注意在聯盟穿梭機之後隨即進場的三艘帝國穿梭機。在「任務完成」訊息出現之前，不要攻擊貨櫃。

entries.source:
Attack secret research
site and steal Corvette in
which a new super shield
technology is being
installed.
entries.target_zh_TW:
攻擊秘密研究基地，
竊取一艘正在
安裝新型超級
護盾技術的
護衛艦。

entries.source: This is the site where an Imperial Corvette is receiving new shields.
entries.target_zh_TW: 一艘帝國護衛艦正在此處加裝新型護盾。

entries.source: Y-wing [[Red One]] will lead a raid to capture this experimental ship.
entries.target_zh_TW: Y翼[[紅色一號]]將率領突襲，俘獲這艘實驗艦。

entries.source: [[Red One]] must locate and disable the Corvette then protect the capture.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色一號]]必須找出並癱瘓這艘護衛艦，然後保護俘獲行動。

entries.source: Once disabled, [[Storm Unit's]] Transport will deliver the capture team.
entries.target_zh_TW: 護衛艦癱瘓後，[[風暴小隊]]的運輸艦會送來俘獲小組。

entries.source: [[Red One]] will be escorted into the area by captured [[Assault]] [[Gunboats]].
entries.target_zh_TW: [[紅色一號]]將由俘獲的[[突擊]][[砲艇]]護送進入此區域。

entries.source: Be prepared to clear mines and fight off Imperial reinforcements!
entries.target_zh_TW: 準備清除水雷並擊退帝國援軍！

entries.source: A heavier version of the Empire's new shield technology is being fitted to a Corellian Corvette.  This prototype is to be captured just before it begins testing.$  The development test site has been made to appear to be an ordinary Patrol Squadron base.  The Imperial Gunboats [[Red]] Squadron helped capture will now be used to escort Y-wing [[Red One]] into the base area.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國的新型護盾技術有一種更重型的版本，正被安裝在一艘柯瑞利亞護衛艦上。這艘原型艦必須在開始測試前被俘獲。$  這座研發測試基地被偽裝成一般的巡邏中隊基地。[[紅色]]中隊協助俘獲的帝國砲艇，現在將護送 Y翼[[紅色一號]]進入基地區域。

entries.source: The Gunboat crews will claim to be escorting a defecting Rebel pilot.  This deception should allow [[Red One]] to get within two kilometers before they discover the ruse.$  [[Red One]] must locate and disable the prototype Corvette while eliminating any Imperial threat.  Then you must protect the capture team when they arrive.  Once captured, the Corvette will be sent on for final preparations.
entries.target_zh_TW: 砲艇的機組人員會宣稱他們正在護送一名叛逃的反抗軍飛行員。這個騙局應能讓[[紅色一號]]在被識破前接近到兩公里以內。$  [[紅色一號]]必須找出並癱瘓這艘原型護衛艦，同時消除帝國的任何威脅。接著，你必須在俘獲小組抵達時保護他們。護衛艦被俘獲後，將被送往進行最後的準備工作。

entries.source: The special CRV is the fifth one in the target list as you cycle forward in the CMD (its spatial position varies.)  As you approach it order your escorts to wait at least 2 klicks away (out of gun range.)$  Use 6 torps at maximum range to destroy the CRV above the special CRV.  Fire 2 torps into special CRV, then clear the mines.  When enemy GUNs arrive, order your escorts to proceed with their mission.
entries.target_zh_TW: 這艘特殊護衛艦是你在 CMD 上向前切換目標時，目標清單中的第五艘（它的空間位置不固定）。接近時，命令你的護航機在至少 2 公里外等待（在砲火射程之外）。$  在最大射程發射 6 枚魚雷，摧毀位於特殊護衛艦上方的那艘護衛艦。對特殊護衛艦發射 2 枚魚雷，然後清除水雷。敵方砲艇抵達時，命令你的護航機繼續執行它們的任務。

entries.source: WE HAVE CAPTURED THE EMPIRE'S NEW SHIELD TECHNOLOGY
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們奪得了帝國的新型護盾技術

entries.source:
Defend a newly captured
Corvette as it is being out-
fitted for its attack 
mission against an Imperial
shipyard.
entries.target_zh_TW:
保衛一艘
剛俘獲的護衛艦，
它正在整裝，準備
執行攻擊帝國船塢的
任務。

entries.source: Congratulations on the capture of the Corvette [[Blade 5]].  This specially modified ship is the key element in Operation "[[Ram's Head]]."$  The plan was first proposed after the loss of the Freighter [[Sarsuma ]]during[[ ]]Operation "[[Grain Snatch]]."  Analysis of the flight data suggested that perhaps a Freighter or other vessel could somehow be used to decapitate a Star Destroyer by ramming its bridge.
entries.target_zh_TW: 恭喜你們俘獲了護衛艦[[利刃 5 號]]。這艘經過特殊改裝的船艦，是「[[公羊頭]]」行動的關鍵。$  這項計畫最初是在「[[奪取穀物]]」行動中失去貨船[[ ]][[薩蘇瑪號]]後提出的。分析飛行資料後發現，也許能以某種方式利用貨船或其他船艦衝撞滅星者的艦橋，將其斬首。

entries.source: The [[Ram's Head]] must transfer personnel to prepare it for use.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[公羊頭號]]必須進行人員轉移，為投入使用做好準備。

entries.source: Our Corvette [[Libra]] is waiting for the captured ship [[Ram's Head]] to arrive.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我方護衛艦[[天秤號]]正等待俘獲的[[公羊頭號]]抵達。

entries.source: X-wing [[Red]] is to secure the area during the personnel transfer.
entries.target_zh_TW: 人員轉移期間，X翼[[紅色中隊]]負責確保此區域安全。

entries.source: Before you go on this mission the entire [[Alliance High Command]] would like to take this opportunity to congratulate [[Red]] Squadron for your terrific successes so far.  Special thanks are due [[Red One]].  Without your skills and dedication the Rebellion could not continue!  Good luck, and may the force be with you.$$>CLICK ON THE BLACK PAGE NUMBER$>BOX TO SEE THE HINT(S).
entries.target_zh_TW: 在你出發執行這次任務前，[[聯盟最高指揮部]]全體成員想藉此機會，恭喜[[紅色]]中隊至今取得的輝煌戰果。特別要感謝[[紅色一號]]。若沒有你的技術與奉獻，反抗軍無法延續下去！祝你好運，願原力與你同在。$$>點擊黑色頁碼$>方塊即可查看提示。

entries.source: The new shield technology used on [[Blade 5]] promises to make this idea feasible.  The captured Corvette has been renamed "[[Ram's Head]]" in honor of the operation it is to be used in.$  Operation "[[Ram's Head]]" will strike an Imperial Deep Dock where several Star Destroyers are being repaired.  The Interdictor Cruisers that normally protect the dock have been lured away by an Alliance trick.
entries.target_zh_TW: [[利刃 5 號]]所使用的新型護盾技術，讓這個構想得以實現。這艘俘獲的護衛艦已更名為「[[公羊頭號]]」，以紀念它即將投入的行動。$  「[[公羊頭]]」行動將攻擊一座帝國深空船塢，那裡有數艘滅星者正在維修。平時保護船塢的禁制者級巡洋艦，已被聯盟的計謀引開。

entries.source: This mission is similar to the 1st one of this tour only harder.$  Head toward the FRG as soon as it appears.  T/Bs are the main threat again and you have to be quick.$  You will be attacked by T/As instead of T/Fs but you should evade them the same way.$  A CRV arrives at [[9:00]] minutes into the mission and a couple of TRNs arrive at [[10:30]], so save some torpedoes!
entries.target_zh_TW: 本任務與本服役期的第一個任務類似，只是難度更高。$  巡防艦一出現就立刻朝它飛去。鈦轟炸機同樣是主要威脅，動作一定要快。$  這次來襲的是鈦先進型戰機而不是鈦戰機，但閃避方式相同。$  任務開始後 [[9:00]] 會有一艘護衛艦抵達，[[10:30]] 則會有幾艘運輸艦抵達，所以要保留一些魚雷！

entries.source: Our finest technicians are waiting aboard the Corvette [[Libra]].  They have special equipment to complete the final preparations on the [[Ram's Head]].  When the [[Ram's Head]] arrives they will transfer to it.  This will take about [[ten]] minutes.$  [[Red]] Squadron will send three X-wings to the rendezvous point to protect this transfer.  You must ensure that the [[Ram's Head]] makes it to safety.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們最優秀的技術人員正在護衛艦[[天秤號]]上待命。他們帶著特殊裝備，要為[[公羊頭號]]完成最後的準備工作。[[公羊頭號]]抵達後，他們將轉移過去，過程約需[[十]]分鐘。$  [[紅色]]中隊將派出三架 X翼戰機前往會合點，保護這次轉移。你必須確保[[公羊頭號]]安全脫離。

entries.source: Thank you, Red One, the Ram's Head is safe
entries.target_zh_TW: 謝謝你，紅色一號，公羊頭號安全了

entries.source: Operation Ram's Head will proceed now
entries.target_zh_TW: 公羊頭行動現在可以展開了

entries.source: MAY THE FORCE BE WITH US ALL
